PDF Multi-dimensional Transfer Functions for Interactive 3D Flow Visualization
Abstract Transfer functions are a standard technique used in volume rendering to assign color and opacity to a volume of a scalar field. Multi-dimensional transfer functions (MDTFs) have proven to be an effective way to extract specific features with subtle properties.
